tasks.short: Type administrative documents and answer telephone calls.

steps.what: Answer the actual telephone call, listen to the caller's need, clarify the message and respond within the attendant's role
Look up and check the current funeral-file detail or approved general information needed to answer the actual caller
Write and check the actual call message, callback need and facts confirmed with the caller in the internal case note
Save the exact checked actual call note v1 in the correct internal funeral file
Type the requested administrative document using checked funeral-file facts and the director's explicit content instructions
Review the exact completed administrative document v1 for names, dates, instructions, confidentiality and intended internal draft location
Save the exact approved administrative document v1 to the internal funeral-file draft location

tasks.design: Configure native case lookup in the funeral case-management system in {OTHER} and approved administrative document merging into {DOCS}. The attendant keeps the actual telephone conversation and message capture, checks the assembled document and saves each completed version separately; native field reuse comes before any custom code or model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff can repeatedly navigate case details and retype the same checked facts into routine documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case filters and document field merging can reuse known facts.
tasks.still_hard: Grief, ambiguous requests and sensitive family information require careful listening and checking.
tasks.human_edge: Respond with care and recognise when the funeral director must take over.

ambition.what: No extra authority to agree funeral arrangements or release public notices.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated case navigation and document typing; caller contact remains human.

reach.learn: Which requests can be answered directly and which require the arranger's decision

evidence.claim: Native case lookup and document merges can reuse checked administrative fields without replacing telephone conversations.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual calls, lookup, call-note writing and saving, and typing/checking/saving administrative drafts. Public obituary preparation is allocated to its own task, not counted again here. Shares are provisional rather than observed.

The funeral director already maintains case ID, checked names, contact permissions, ceremony date/time/place and explicit administrative instructions in the funeral file. Missing or changed facts are checked manually with the director within s2/s5; the tool does not infer arrangements from an earlier call.
The attendant produces actual caller identity, request, message and callback needs in s1/s3; capture time remains whole. No ambient recording, transcript or automatic callback message is assumed.

The 50% s5 reduction applies to repeated template typing only; bespoke prose and missing fields remain manual. The attendant checks final names, dates and meaning in s5-s6. The document is an internal draft; any later family approval or external send must occur after the final version and have its own action step.
Edits void each save approval. Ordinary same-system saves and existing runtime earn no saving. No new data collection is transferred to the family.
unknowns: Proportion of routine documents with repeated checked fields
research_questions: Which typed fields already exist in the funeral file and which require new manual confirmation?

already_counted.description: Check relevant case information and source applicability
Capture and check actual caller message
Check merged document and write unsupported content

incremental.description: Maintain administrative template fields and case-lookup views

approvals.approved_version: actual call note v1 and correct case
administrative document v1 and internal draft location

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 2.5 case-lookup plus 10 repeated-typing points less 0.8 upkeep = 11.7. Low assumes bespoke requests and missing checked fields keep most typing manual; calls, actual message capture and final review keep full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Telephone support remains personal; routine document preparation can take less typing.
reach: Morticians, Undertakers, and Funeral Arrangers: clarify administrative limits and escalation needs
role.ambitious_version: A funeral attendant who supports callers with care and produces accurate administrative drafts from confirmed arrangements.
